name: cluecab-keyboard
description: Vendored fork of @capacitor/keyboard 8.0.5: the keyboardWillShow payload carries the animation's durationMs and curve, so the composer can ride the keyboard on its real timing. The resize schedule is untouched — see ios/Sources/KeyboardPlugin/Keyboard.m for the whole diff and why the +0.2s delay must stay. The android/ half is new, not upstream's: it keeps the same 'body' contract (willShow with height and durationMs before anything moves, the WebView never resized, document.body shrunk after the animation) so src/ui/nativeKeyboard.ts runs unchanged on Android.
